items.headline: audio.cpp: 12 audio models (Qwen3-TTS, PocketTTS, VeVo2 etc) in 1 C++/ggml runtime — TTS up to 5x faster than Python on CUDA
items.summary: I’ve been working on audio.cpp, a native C++ inference framework for audio models built on top of ggml. The framework currently has 25 model families, but I want to be precise about its state: 12 are released in the repo now and ready for normal use. I’m not counting anything still in integration or optimization as released.q The released set already covers quite a bit: TTS / voice cloning / voice design: Chatterbox, MioTTS, OmniVoice, PocketTTS, Qwen3-TTS and VoxCPM2 ASR / alignment / VAD
